scientific_integrity: Exact analytic frame classification; proof uses the standard Zak/Parseval criterion, Jacobi triple product, and an explicit parity-Wronskian factorization. Numerical checks are finite corroboration, not certification.
scientific_limitations: Rectangular lattice product exactly 1/2, affine polynomial Gaussian windows, no explicit optimal frame bounds or uniform quantitative stability as the Gaussian coefficient tends to zero; independent priority check not performed.
title: Exact half-density Gabor-frame classification of Gaussian–first-Hermite mixtures
